objects.description: During the [SolarWinds Compromise](https://attack.mitre.org/campaigns/C0024), [APT29](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0016) used `Rundll32.exe` to execute payloads.(Citation: Microsoft - Customer Guidance on Recent Nation-State Cyber Attacks)(Citation: Microsoft Deep Dive Solorigate January 2021)
objects.description_fa: در طول [سازش SolarWinds](https://attack.mitre.org/campaigns/C0024)، [APT29](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0016) از «Rundll32.exe» برای اجرای بارهای پرداخت استفاده کرد.(Citation: Microsoft - Customer Guidance on Recent Nation-State Cyber Attacks)[[[CTI_PRESERVE_1] (Citation: Microsoft Deep Dive Solorigate January 2021)
